description: enables the default permissions plus the exit-flow commands, the macOS privacy-permission commands, opening the app's notification settings in the system's settings app, the menu labels, the menu bar icon's menu, raising the window for the exit confirmation, the settings the shell reads at startup (running in the background, the menu bar icon), the keep-awake choice, launching at login and opening the system's list of login items, the Dock badge, system notifications, reading and writing clipboard text, saving and opening the configuration file and choosing a directory in the system's dialogs, checking for and installing a new version, opening a link in the system's browser, native window theming, revealing the window the shell creates hidden through the shell, and dragging and zooming it by the UI's own top bar
